title: Leslie Kean publishes the Grusch article in The Debrief after the New York Times passes

tellings.quote:
Leslie Kane published the initial
article that prompted the whole thing
but she had to do it in the debrief
because Julian Barnes

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that in 2023 the journalist Leslie Kean published the first article about David Grusch, a witness whose claims of secret government UFO programs set off a wave of public attention. Michels says Kean had to publish it in The Debrief, a smaller online news outlet, because the New York Times passed on it, and he connects that decision to a Times reporter named Julian Barnes.
